purpose: Central record of in-game live tests and the capability families they promote. Generators read it through scripts/live_evidence.py; a family is live_proven only when a user-run test passed on it, and only live_proven families drop allow_unverified_effect, within the scope stated here.

statusLevels.live_proven: A user-run in-game test showed the intended effect; the acknowledgement requirement is removed for exactly the family scope.
statusLevels.not_tested: The write applied cleanly in game but the effect was not observed; stays offline-proven with its acknowledgement.
statusLevels.inconclusive: The write applied cleanly but the observation cannot confirm or refute the effect; stays offline-proven, acknowledgement required.
statusLevels.live_failed: A user-run test applied the write cleanly but the intended effect did not occur. The capability is withdrawn for exactly that scope (read-only, with the reason) until the cause is corrected and re-tested.
statusLevels.pending: Not yet shown in game: built for a live test that has not run, or run only against a source later found not to be consumed. Writes keep their acknowledgements.

evidenceModel.donorOutputWorks: the donor projectile or output renders and functions when some host fires it
evidenceModel.referenceWriteSucceeded: Runtime resolved the target and the guarded write applied (APPLIED in the log)
evidenceModel.hostReadsReference: the host's live firing path consumes the member that was written
evidenceModel.gameplayOutputChanged: the host visibly fired the new output in play
evidenceModel.note: A failed host is host-path evidence, never evidence against the donor output. null means the test did not establish that part.

sessions.runtime: HD2Runtime 0.27.0 coverage test build (commit c99d338, build/test-artifacts/coverage-build)

tests.observation: The AC-8 turns dramatically faster; the difference is very obvious in gameplay.
The MG-43 ignores enemies at normal sentry distances and begins targeting only when they are very close.

The launcher deployed mines into only one portion (quadrant) of its normal 360-degree pattern instead of distributing fewer mines evenly around the circle. Reducing the salvo count truncates the normal angular deployment sequence: successive salvos cover different rotational sectors.
Liberator bullets set enemies on fire; the ballistic attack otherwise behaved normally.

Maxigun bullets stun enemies. The observed stun lasted about 1-2 s rather than the catalogued 3 s of Stun Medium. The cause is not established; see research/status-susceptibility-F5FEE03DCFDB.json. Status duration semantics are unchanged.
Normal Chargers became extremely easy to kill with ordinary weapons; Charger Behemoths stayed tanky, so the write reached the intended class only.
Liberator and Stalwart light-penetration shots damaged the Charger's head instead of bouncing; other armored areas still behaved armored.
Applied cleanly, but the Spewer artillery attack could not be reliably provoked in play.
Fabricators tested appeared to need roughly the usual number of Railgun shots. Only one of five fabricator variants was edited and the variant cannot be identified in game, so this is not a failure.

tests.observation: With nobody carrying the Talon, the Reprimand fired Talon bolts with correct visuals and function. Edits the mod made to the Talon projectile were observable through the swap.

tests.mod: Liberator -> Talon projectile swap (user-built; new and older API)
tests.observation: Runtime resolved and wrote the reference; the Liberator kept firing its normal bullet. The same result with the older projectile-swap API.
tests.hostPath: Explained offline (research/active-projectile-sources-F5FEE03DCFDB.json): the Liberator's default ammunition customization, RIFLE 5,5x50mm. FULL METAL JACKET, patches ProjectileWeapon +0 when the weapon is built, so the written base member is dormant. The Reprimand has no ammunition customization. The Talon output itself is live-proven by the Reprimand test.

tests.observation: Run by the user; recorded as unproven pending the host-path issue. The choice wrote the same dormant member as the failed Talon control, so it says nothing about the EAT-700 output.

sentry_turret_turn_speed.scope: Every turreted sentry: the same TurretComponent members, equal to the wiki turn-speed tables on all nine.

sentry_targeting_range.scope: Every sentry with a SensorEye range: the same SensorEyeComponent member, equal to the seven wiki-stated ranges.

minefield_salvos.scope: All four minefields: the same ThrowerComponent slot-0 member, proven by the wiki sentence, the type library and the launch sockets. Reduce-only is kept.
minefield_salvos.behaviour: Salvos are sequential launcher sweeps over different rotational sectors; reducing the count truncates the angular deployment (fewer sectors covered), it does not thin mines evenly around 360 degrees.

weapon_projectile_status_reference.scope: Status slot references (attach, swap, clear) on the direct-hit DamageInfo row of player and support weapon projectile attacks. Every write still re-proves the status identity from the game's own status table.
observations: Stun Medium held targets about 1-2 s instead of the catalogued 3 s; cause not established.
notPromoted: status slots on explosion, spray, beam, arc and melee DamageInfo rows
status slots on vehicle mounted weapons

enemy_main_health.scope: Main health of every enemy class (not structures): the gameplay-proven HealthComponent member, now observed on enemies.

enemy_zone_armor.scope: Damage-zone armor of every enemy class (not structures).

fields: attack DamageInfo, ProjectileSettings and ExplosionSettings fields

structure_health.scope: Health of enemy structures. Writes require allow_unverified_effect until a structure live test passes.
structure_health.analysis: Offline data offers one explanation, not established: the fabricator's fatal 'insides' zone has its own 400-health pool and forwards 0% of its damage to main health, so a fabricator destroyed through that zone needs the same shots whether or not main health changed.

weapon_projectile_reference_direct.scope: Projectile-reference replacement on player attacks whose written member is their active projectile source (ACTIVE_DIRECT in sdk/AttackOutputCapabilities.json projectileSources). Proven on the SMG-32 Reprimand. The structural rule that classifies the other ACTIVE_DIRECT attacks (no customization delta patches a projectile member, no other selector) is checked against the Reprimand (positive) and Liberator (negative) controls.
observations: Same-class replacement never required an acknowledgement; this family records the host path.
notPromoted: attacks whose source is INDIRECT, AMBIGUOUS or BLOCKED (read-only)

weapon_projectile_reference_dormant_memb.scope: Writing the base ProjectileWeapon +0 member of an attack whose default ammunition customization patches that member at weapon build. Withdrawn: those fields are read-only with DORMANT_PROJECTILE_REFERENCE and point to weapon:ammunition():projectile().
tests: Liberator -> Talon projectile swap (user-built; new and older API)
weapon_projectile_reference_dormant_memb.analysis: A structural reference existing, and a guarded write landing, did not prove that firing reads it. The Liberator fires its FULL METAL JACKET ammunition delta; see docs/attack-outputs.md.

weapon_ammunition_projectile_reference.scope: Replacing the projectile of a weapon's default ammunition customization, its active source when the ammunition delta patches ProjectileWeapon +0. Requires allow_shared and allow_unverified_effect.

attack_output_cross_class.scope: A projectile output from another structural class (rocket, arc grenade) on a projectile host. Requires allow_unverified_reference and allow_unverified_effect.
observations: The pre-correction EAT-700 and GL-52 runs wrote the Liberator's dormant member, so they carry no evidence either way about those outputs.
